visualCharacteristics.purpose: loads an HTML/CSS/JS widget from /widgets/ for interactive, data-driven features that are not authorable content
visualCharacteristics.summary: The widget block is selected by the linked widget name (/widgets/course-finder), not a CSS variant; no variant name justified.

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: a link to /widgets/<name> (e.g. /widgets/course-finder). Query parameters on the link become data-* config on the widget element (e.g. /widgets/course-finder?base=https://www.unir.net routes the finder to the source site). The block takes the widget name as its class
contentPattern.summary: Course finder: Interactive filter/search form driven by data (options, static page routing); not authorable as default content. Uses the project widget block (e.g. /widgets/course-finder).

usage: Course finder under the home hero (/widgets/course-finder: tipo de estudio, área, oficialidad, "Encuentra tu título"), light-grey section style.
reuseGuidance: Use only for interactive features (forms, finders, calculators). Build the widget as /widgets/<name>.html/.css/.js; never fork this block per widget.
